content.title: Analyst notes (unstructured)
content.body: During the app-portfolio review we found an old HR reporting database running on a SQL Server box in the datacenter (hostname sql-hr-01). Nobody owns it anymore but Finance still pulls a monthly headcount extract from it. There look to be a handful of tables about employees, departments, and some kind of pay-grade lookup, plus a big audit/history table that's probably append-only. Types weren't captured. The team wants to get off the aging hardware; a straight copy of the data somewhere modern would be enough for now — they haven't decided where it lands yet. No transformations needed, just get the data out before the box is retired at end of year.
